name: Main
prompt:
Produce Dzmitry's **Main** crypto scenario brief (24×7, every 4 hours). Routine name: **Main**. He is long-only, buy-the-dip / sell-in-strength, restricted to this coin list only: BTC, ETH, ARB, HYPE, PUMP, ENA, SKY, JUP, AAVE, AERO, LDO, UNI, RAY, POL, SYRUP, ZRO, ICP, DASH, LINK, CRV, MORPHO, SUI, ZEN, NEAR, SOL, VVV. Never short. Never recommend coins outside the list.

Use the connected CoinMarketCap connector for live quotes, technicals, global metrics, and derivatives. Resolve tickers carefully (watch collisions: SKY, PUMP, HYPE, POL, ZEN, VVV, etc.). Prefer CMC over web scrape.

Also use Revolut X via the revx CLI (already authenticated) for his LIVE book: account balances, open orders, and tickers for held/open symbols. If revx auth fails, say so and still deliver the market brief.

Binance futures positioning (PUBLIC, no API key): prefer www.binance.com paths (fapi is geo-blocked). Fetch top-trader POSITION L/S (primary), top-trader ACCOUNT L/S, global L/S, taker buy/sell, OI hist, basis, premiumIndex, fundingRate. Always BTC+ETH; also held or top-dip / open-book candidates with a USDT perp (RAY: prefer RAYSOLUSDT if RAYUSDT empty). Report latest 1h plus DYNAMIC vs prior bars.

Liquidations (free feeds; Coinglass plan may be blocked): Xoomar liquidations aggregate; ByKaranteli backup. Summarize 24h long vs short and recent flush character.

FLUSH DETECTOR (required): If BTC 1h high-low > ~1.5% of spot, OR clear long-liq spike vs prior hours, OR OI/price shock (OI drop with price down) → do NOT keep Range as highest prob; set Bear ≥40% (unless clear short-flush bounce underway); widen bands; one-line "Flush detector: ON — …". Else "Flush detector: off".

REQUIRED: Use Binance top-trader POSITION dynamics in tactics (entries/leaves/cancels/ladders), not only as a data block. Also use funding/basis/premium/liqs. Crowding caution: ETH, SKY, BTC, AAVE (LINK/ARB on 4h, AERO extremes). Do NOT fade high L/S on UNI, ZRO, VVV, ICP. δ-momentum: JUP, HYPE, NEAR, LDO, RAYSOL, SUI. Hint only.

Dip zones: each ranked buy-zone midpoint roughly ≥1.5–3% below spot; always include invalidation.

For the NEXT ~4 HOURS (as-of Europe/Madrid and UTC), deliver ONE cohesive brief (all sections in the same message — do NOT split Binance into a separate thread or aside):

1) BTC and ETH bull/bear/range — ranges + probs summing to 100% each (apply flush detector).

2) Top **6** buy-the-dip FROM THE LIST ONLY, **sorted by priority 1–6** (best first). For each: price, why dip vs strength, buy zone / invalidation / strength, best-fit scenario, and how Binance top-trader position + funding/basis/liqs supports or warns. If fewer than 6 qualify, say so and only list real dips — no padding with chase/strength names.

3) Open book (RevX) + SUGGESTIONS (leave/tighten/cancel/add). State concrete limit prices and USD sizes for any suggested new buys.

4) Binance derivatives block in the SAME brief: BTC+ETH (+ relevant list names) with top-trader position L/S, account L/S, global L/S, taker, OI, funding, premium/basis, and 1-line dynamics.

5) Liquidations one-liner.

6) One-line CMC backdrop.

## NIGHT AUTO-EXECUTE (explicit standing approval)

Determine local Europe/Madrid hour at run time.

**Night window:** from 22:00 inclusive through 08:00 exclusive (22:00–07:59 Madrid). Day window: 08:00–21:59 Madrid.

**During NIGHT runs only**, Dzmitry has pre-approved automatic execution of this brief's suggested Revolut X actions, with these hard limits:

- **Place** the suggested new **buy limit** orders from section 3 / top dips, using `revx` (limit buys only; never market buys; never shorts/sells to open).
- **Total notional cap:** sum of newly placed buy quote amounts in THIS run must be **≤ $1000 USD**. If suggestions exceed $1000, place highest-priority dips first until the cap; skip the rest and say what was skipped.
- Prefer typical rung sizes of ~$100–$200 unless the suggestion names otherwise, still respecting the $1000 cap.
- **Cancels** of open buy bids that this brief marks cancel/replace are allowed at night (cancels do not count against the $1000 place cap). Do not cancel-all.
- After acting, report exactly what was placed/cancelled (prices, sizes, order ids) in the same notification.
- If revx auth fails or a place/cancel errors, report the failure and do not retry blindly beyond one careful retry.

**During DAY runs (08:00–21:59 Madrid):** SUGGEST only. Do **not** place/cancel/modify orders unless a later explicit user confirmation in chat asks.

Always notify with the full brief — never stay silent. After notifying, append one structured JSON line to /workspace/crypto-self-reflect/briefs.jsonl with: routine="Main", as_of_madrid, btc/eth spot, probs, ranges, flush_detector, top6 dips with zones/inv/priority, night_auto (true/false), orders_placed / orders_cancelled summaries — so Tactical and morning self-reflect can reuse context.

Be concise and trader-useful. If CMC auth fails repeatedly, say so and pause this routine.
